samples.summary: The link card's placement pass duplicates the comment popover's placement pass rather than reusing it, contrary to what the design doc claims. sheet-view.tsx now contains two near-identical useLayoutEffect blocks (lines 1537-1610 for CommentPopover, 1625-1665 for the link card): same `getGridViewportRect()` + `getCellRect()` composition, same try/catch bail, same zero-size wrapper bail, same GAP/PAD clamp, same identity-preserving setState. docs/design/sheets/sheet-hyperlink.md §5 says the card "reuses the flip/clamp measurement pass at `sheet-view.tsx:1479-1550`" — it copies it. A shared `useAnchoredPopoverPosition(sheetRef, ref, cellRef, options)` hook was the available reuse, and the repo's stated expectation is reuse. Cost stays inside the codebase (two copies of cell→container coordinate math to keep in step with zoom/scroll/freeze), so minor — but the doc overstating it as reuse is itself part of the finding.
samples.evidence: Duplicated block: viewport/cellRect composition, popoverRect zero-size bail, GAP/PAD clamp, prev-identity setState — present at both 1537-1610 and 1625-1665.

samples.summary: The new design doc plans a persisted hyperlink field as `Cell.link?: string` (comparison-table option A, and Roadmap step 3) while the existing canonical doc for that model extension, docs/design/sheets/xlsx-style-import.md §4 / Rollout Phase 3, already specifies the same field as `Cell.lk` ("hyperlink target URL", "wire renderer + toolbar + Yorkie schema"). Neither doc cross-references the other, so the repo now carries two design docs planning the same future model field under two different names, with xlsx import attached to one and the sheets link roadmap attached to the other. The repo's doc discipline is to fold into the canonical subsystem doc rather than file a parallel plan; at minimum the roadmap step should name `Cell.lk` and link xlsx-style-import.md Phase 3. No behavioral cost today, hence minor.
samples.evidence: xlsx-style-import.md:167 `lk?: string;   // hyperlink target URL`; :223 "Phase 3 — model extension. Add ... `Cell.lk` (hyperlink)" vs sheet-hyperlink.md:52 "**A. `Cell.link?: string`**" and :316-319 roadmap step 3.

samples.summary: The hover card ships with `role="dialog"` (plus `aria-label`) on a non-modal, pointer-only hover surface. The design doc §5 itself states the card "is not opened by a click and owns no focus, so pointer-leave is the whole lifecycle", and the task's Known Limitations record that `role="dialog"` "is not the right role for a non-modal hover card". Shipping a dialog role that nothing can focus or dismiss by keyboard misreports the widget to assistive tech, and the new test asserts `getByRole("dialog")`, which cements the wrong shape into the suite. A plain container (or `role="tooltip"` with the pointer handlers on the wrapper) would match what was designed.
samples.evidence: SheetLinkPopover.tsx: `role="dialog" aria-label="Links in this cell"`; SheetLinkPopover.test.tsx: `screen.getByRole("dialog")`.

samples.summary: Only `Mod+Click` reaches the shortcuts help sheet; the read-only viewer's plain-click-opens behavior — the discoverability gap the originating issue is built around ("the document is shared view-only, where a reader has no reason to guess a modifier") — is documented nowhere in-product. The catalog entry satisfies the issue's explicit step, so this is a nit, but the one gesture a viewer actually gets is the undocumented one.

The shared home for URL primitives is `@wafflebase/core/url` (which exists precisely because `isSafeUrl` had already diverged between Docs and Sheets). The sheets rule is deliberately stricter (bracket balancing, no schemeless hosts) and the doc argues that divergence well, so this is a reuse opportunity rather than a requirement — but the trailing-punctuation rule specifically is the same question answered twice and will drift.
